question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**content**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the water quantity in root crops.
 
• The appropriate word should describe the amount of water present in these vegetables.
 
• "**Content**" (मात्रा) fits well as it accurately describes the amount of a particular constituent (water) in the root crops.
 
• Other options ("**gain**", "**utility**", "**worth**") do not fit well in the context of describing the amount of water.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The roots of some plants get swollen with the presence__ of storage food which can be used as vegetables. The plants which have such roots are called root crops. These are *__*nutritious*__ *staple foods with **__energy__ giving carbohydrates. These also have large water *__*content*__*. Some (5)________ are carrots, beetroots, radishes, turnip, sweet potato etc.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Gain **(लाभ): "Gain" refers to increase or acquire, which does not describe the quantity of water in root crops.
 
• **Utility** (उपयोगिता): "Utility" means usefulness, which is not relevant to the context of the amount of water in root crops.
 
• **Worth **(मूल्य): "Worth" refers to value, which again is not specifically related to the water quantity in the vegetables.
